title: A coding-independent function of gene and pseudogene mRNAs regulates tumour biology
central_claims: PTENP1 pseudogene transcripts compete for microRNAs, regulate PTEN expression and suppress growth independently of protein coding, with analogous coding-independent functions for other transcripts.

source_manifest.title: Replication Study: A coding-independent function of gene and pseudogene mRNAs regulates tumour biology
source_manifest.finding: DU145 PTEN/PTENP1 cross-regulation at mRNA level and several proliferation tests were not reproduced, although protein-expression and PTEN3-prime-UTR growth effects partly agreed; controls/variance qualify inference.

source_manifest.title: Pseudogene PTENP1 functions as a competing endogenous RNA to suppress clear-cell renal cell carcinoma progression.
source_manifest.finding: Independent renal-cell carcinoma experiments support PTENP1 miR21 competition, tumor suppression and chemotherapy sensitization.

source_manifest.title: Divergent Activity of the Pseudogene PTENP1 in ER-Positive and Negative Breast Cancer.
source_manifest.finding: Independent breast-cancer experiments report opposite PTENP1 effects by estrogen-receptor status: suppressive in ER-negative settings and growth-promoting in ER-positive models.

research.summary: Independent tumor-type extensions show substantive biological uptake and some benefit, alongside mixed original-system replication and opposite ER-positive effects. This is context-dependent success, not uniformly confirmed tumor suppression.
